What is Phrase?

Enterprise localisation suite combining a translation management system, a CAT tool, automatic MT engine selection across 30+ engines, quality prediction and an orchestration layer - the most complete enterprise offering in this group.

Best for

Large-scale enterprise localisation governance across many content types and vendors.

Main features

  • Phrase Language AI with automatic MT engine selection per content type and language pair
  • Phrase QPS (Quality Performance Score) predicting translation quality per segment
  • Phrase TMS (CAT and project management)
  • Phrase Strings for software
  • Phrase Portal for self-serve business users
  • Phrase Analytics
  • Custom AI models trained on your TM
  • Auto LQA.

Practical use cases

  • Centralising localisation across product, marketing, support and legal
  • routing only low-confidence segments to human review using QPS
  • managing a vendor network under one system
  • meeting regulated-industry audit requirements for translated content.

Who is it for?

  • Large enterprises, LSPs (language service providers), regulated industries, global marketing and product organisations.

Pricing, free access & limits

Modular subscription - separate products (TMS, Strings, Language AI, Orchestrator) priced per seat plus volume

Plans described in the source

Phrase Strings starts around $27-33/user/mo for small teams. Phrase TMS entry tiers start in the low hundreds per month. Language AI is priced by translated character/word volume on top. Enterprise bundles quoted annually and typically run into five or six figures per year. There is no simple single price - the modular structure means a quote is required for anything beyond the smallest Strings plan.

Free plan

No permanent free plan; free trial only. Some academic and open-source programmes exist.

Free trial

Yes - 14-day free trials on Strings and TMS.

Usage limits to consider

Each module has its own seat and volume limits; Language AI character volumes are metered; advanced features (Custom AI, Orchestrator, Auto LQA) are enterprise-tier only.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Automatic MT engine selection across 30+ engines genuinely beats picking one engine
  • QPS lets you route only risky segments to humans, which is where the cost savings are
  • deepest connector library in the category
  • strong compliance and audit posture for regulated industries.

Limitations to consider

  • The most complex product here - implementation typically needs weeks and often a partner
  • modular pricing is genuinely difficult to forecast
  • expensive
  • heavy administrative overhead for small teams
  • the UI shows its age in places after the Memsource/PhraseApp merger.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, desktop CAT editor (Windows/macOS), mobile app for review, CLI, API

Languages

  • 500+ languages via engine aggregation; full RTL support for Arabic; French and all major languages

API access

Yes - extensive REST APIs across TMS and Strings, plus CLI and webhooks

Integrations and exports

  • 50+ connectors: Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Contentful, WordPress, Drupal, Salesforce, GitHub, GitLab, Figma, Zendesk, Marketo, SharePoint, Google Drive

Evaluation notes

QPS quality prediction is the feature with the clearest ROI - it is what turns MT volume into actual human-review savings. Insist on a proof of concept using your own content before committing to an annual contract.
